name: Financial Assistance for Tagore Cultural Complexes (TCC)
benefit:
**Nature and Extent of Financial Assistance**

1. Financial assistance under the scheme component for any project will normally be up to a maximum of ₹15 crores. In extremely rare cases, of outstanding merit and relevance, the financial assistance can go up to ₹ 50 crores, but then each such individual case of Central assistance beyond ₹15 crores will be subjected to the usual appraisal/ approval
_eligibility_text: 1. The organization must be registered as a society under the Registration of Societies Act (XXI of 1860) or under a similar Act, or as a Trust or Not-for-Profit Company for at least three years. 1. The organization’s charter must be primarily devoted to the preservation, propagation, and promotion of Indian arts and culture. 1. The organization must have a predominantly cultural profile and should have been actively working in fields such as dance, drama, theatre, music, fine arts, Indology, and literature for at least three years. 1. The organization must be well established and recognized for doing meaningful work in its field of activity. 1. The organization must have gained a local, regional, or national identity and reputation/standing. 1. The organization must be capable of setting up and operating the project effectively. 1. The organization must be able to arrange 40% of the project cost (for Non-North Eastern Region projects) or 10% (for North Eastern Region projects) as its matching share. 1. The organization must be capable of meeting the recurring costs of the project. 1. The organization must have been inspected and recommended by an appropriate agency of the Central Government or the concerned State Government/UT Administration.
